lines: A request the server cannot read no longer stops it, and a hostile email or page can no longer freeze it or a tab.
Tapping a Vault row on a phone shows its own title at once, and Sign Out always ends the sign-in, even before the Space answers.
A part of the app that loads on request shows a small Retry if its code fails, and keeps what you typed when it opens.
Syncs start in turns, not in one wave, so a big Space stays responsive while it syncs.
Flows know the record behind a form, button or stage move, and every {{ }} is checked when you save; older Flows keep running.
Mail in Windows-1252 shows its quotes and dashes, and a Vault fill only goes into frames of the page's own site.
